Sony tries to explain that its AI Camera Assistant doesn’t suck
stories.dek:
The variety of terrible is impressive.	

After Sony drew some unwanted attention for a post demonstrating its AI Camera Assistant on the Xperia 1 XIII, it's trying to clarify how the feature works. The company says it doesn't edit photos, but makes suggestions based on lighting, depth, and subject.
